title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12

ai_review.summary: A remarkable Fillmore East show with standout Pigpen performances captured on a rough but listenable audience tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the July 1970 Fillmore East concert – especially the acoustic Pigpen set, “It's A Man’s World”, “Turn On Your Lovelight” and the tight Tighten‑Up jam – calling it one of the band’s best late‑summer shows. The recording is an audience source with hand‑claps, occasional muffled sections and a slight speed issue, but listeners find it enjoyable with EQ or a modest speed boost.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is universally praised (most 5‑star reviews) while the audience recording is noted as uneven but still enjoyable, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with hand‑clapping and lobby ambience; some sections are muffled or hard to hear, occasional tape‑speed slowdown noted. EQ and slight speed correction improve listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic Pigpen set opens the midnight show, followed by a New Riders interlude with Garcia on steel, then the electric Dead take over in the early‑morning hours. The pacing is praised as magical and well‑balanced.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s steel‑guitar work with the New Riders is highlighted; fans note he was 'dosed' like the audience but his playing remains a highlight.
